mathematical_result.slope_relation: Selected pairs satisfy a*m=b*n or a*n=b*m for positive a,b in Q.
mathematical_result.degree: Each endpoint index has at most 2*|Q|^2 selected rational-slope neighbours.
mathematical_result.all_rate: For a,b<=floor(exp(epsilon*T/4)), the complete slope packet is at most (32/epsilon^2)*exp(epsilon*T) in absolute value.
mathematical_result.disjoint_sector: The same bound holds after removing edges already counted by additive gaps or exact small integer ratios.
mathematical_result.partition: pickupCross equals additive gap plus disjoint integer ratio plus disjoint rational slope plus the direct reduced-ratio core.
mathematical_result.gcd_effect: A surviving positive pair has reduced numerator or denominator above floor(exp(epsilon*T/4)); for m<n this forces gcd(m,n)<n/H.
mathematical_result.fixed_scale_equivalence: DenseReducedRatioCoreAllRateOn G iff SubexponentialOn pickupCross G with explicit added constant 96/epsilon^2.
mathematical_result.rh_return: AffineFrequent G plus the unproved reduced-ratio core supplier implies the canonical RiemannHypothesis through the existing return.
